rca of the issue: Meta Pixel duplicate: both App.js line 375 (useEffect boot-time) and MarketingPixelLoader.js line 24 (after /api/site-config resolves) call initMetaPixel(). utils/metaPixel.js line 170's `_initAttempted` module-level guard prevents the SECOND JS-side execution of fbq('init'), but on the first pass fbevents.js is loaded via _loadFbqScript() and then fbq('init', PIXEL_ID) is called. When the second call reaches initMetaPixel(), _initAttempted is already true so it returns early — however, the 'Duplicate Pixel ID' warning is fired by fbevents.js itself, indicating that fbq('init', SAME_ID) was invoked twice at some point. The most likely cause: React StrictMode double-invocation of the App.js useEffect in development, OR the guard is being bypassed by a state reset (e.g., notifyConsentGranted at line 198 sets _initAttempted=false and calls initMetaPixel() again — if consent is granted after boot when App.js's initMetaPixel already ran successfully, this re-init WILL trigger fbq('init', SAME_ID) a second time). Fix: add `if (window.__bv_pixel_initialized_id === PIXEL_ID) return;` short-circuit inside initMetaPixel() before line 184, and set `window.__bv_pixel_initialized_id = PIXEL_ID` after success. Alternatively, remove App.js:375 initMetaPixel and let MarketingPixelLoader be the SINGLE injection point (matches iter341 P2 intent stated in the review request).
